# 16 — Frontier: GenAI, on-device ML và kiến trúc hot-path/cold-path

**Ngày nghiên cứu:** 2026-08-21
**Phạm vi:** LLM/GenAI và on-device ML áp dụng được gì cho monetization brain — và quan trọng hơn, **không** áp dụng vào đâu. Nguyên tắc xuyên suốt: *hot path thuộc về bandit/GBDT nhỏ (<10ms), LLM và agent chỉ sống ở cold path.*

## Evidence labels

- **[Primary research]**: paper peer-reviewed/arXiv.
- **[Primary docs]**: docs chính thức của Google/Apple/vendor.
- **[Case study — self-reported]**: số do vendor tự công bố.
- **[Secondary]**: tổng hợp.

---

## A. GenAI cho brain — 4 slot dùng được, 1 slot cấm

### A.1 Sinh creative/offer copy (cold path) — slot chín nhất

- **HLLM-Creator (ByteDance, arXiv:2508.18118):** LLM được tinh chỉnh để sinh nội dung quảng cáo/campaign cho hệ thống marketing nội bộ; pipeline sinh → đánh giá → lọc. [Primary research]
- **Layer.ai × Gamegos:** vendor GenAI chuyên creative game (sinh artwork/copy quảng cáo), công bố case studio casual. [Vendor — self-reported]
- **Hệ quả:** brain không sinh creative tại request time; thay vào đó, **thư viện creative được sinh offline theo segment**, brain chỉ chọn (arm của bandit bao gồm cả creative variant). Điều này biến "creative" thành dimension mới của action space mà không cần LLM ở hot path.

### A.2 Synthetic players — dùng làm red-team/tester, KHÔNG làm predictor

- **Orak benchmark (arXiv:2506.03610v3):** đánh giá khả năng LLM đóng vai agent trong môi trường game; kết quả thận trọng. [Primary research]
- **MDPI (10.3390/info16040329):** nghiên cứu LLM làm player mô phỏng; phát hiện tiêu cực đáng chú ý — **LLM không hành xử như expert player thật**, thiên kiến hệ thống rõ rệt. [Primary research]
- **Cách dùng đúng:** synthetic players để stress-test guardrail, sinh edge case cho decision policy, fuzz-test economy — không bao giờ dùng số của chúng thay cho A/B thật hoặc làm reward signal.

### A.3 Mô phỏng kinh tế game (cold path)

- **RuleSmith** và các hệ agent mô phỏng kinh tế: sinh/cân bằng rule kinh tế bằng LLM agent.
- **Mô phỏng kinh tế MMO bằng LLM agents (arXiv:2506.04699):** phát hiện quan trọng — nếu không tiêm behavioral bias vào agent, **mô phỏng quá duy lý** so với player thật và kết quả sai. [Primary research]
- **MALLES / ECONAI** (kinh tế học + LLM): cùng cảnh báo về giả định rationality.
- **Cách dùng đúng:** dùng mô phỏng làm "dry run" trước khi đưa chính sách giá/offer mới vào experiment thật — như tiền-kiểm thử, không thay thế experiment.

### A.4 Phân tích nguyên nhân và vận hành (cold path)

- LLM agent đọc decision log + metric để đề xuất giả thích vì sao một policy giảm hiệu quả; output là giả thuyết cho analyst, không phải hành động tự động.

### A.5 Slot cấm: LLM trên hot path DECIDE

- DECIDE API (doc 06) phải trả lời trong ngân sách vài ms của game frame / ad request. Không LLM nào hiện nay đáp ứng được với chi phí chấp nhận được ở quy mô hàng triệu request/ngày, kể cả model nhỏ on-device.
- **FunctionGemma (270M, 12/2025)** cho on-device function calling — thú vị cho "warm path" (chuẩn bị context, routing), nhưng không phải cho quyết định monetization latency-critical. [Primary docs — Google Developers]

## B. On-device ML — stack 2026

### B.1 Android: LiteRT là trung tâm

- **TensorFlow Lite đã đổi tên thành LiteRT (9/2024)**, phản ánh chuyển dịch sang runtime tổng quát hơn TFLite; định dạng `.litertlm` cho LLM on-device; GPU delegate mới nhanh hơn ~1.4×. [Primary docs — Google]
- **Stack 2026 khuyến nghị:** LiteRT (inference) + MediaPipe (pipeline cảm biến/xử lý) + ML Kit (tác vụ dựng sẵn) + NNAPI/GPU delegate (acceleration) + Gemini Nano (LLM nhỏ on-device qua AICore). [Primary docs]
- **Với brain:** model bandit/GBDT xuất ra LiteRT đủ nhỏ để chạy <5ms trên máy trung bình; đây là lựa chọn mặc định cho decision inference phía client (doc 15, MVP wedge).

### B.2 iOS: Apple Foundation Models & Private Cloud Compute

- **Apple Foundation Models (AFM):** mô hình on-device ~3B tham số làm nền cho Apple Intelligence; các tác vụ vượt khả năng on-device được chuyển sang **Private Cloud Compute (PCC)** với cam kết không lưu dữ liệu và xử lý kiểm toán được. [Primary docs — Apple ML Research / Security]
- **WWDC 2026 (6/2026):** Apple công bố thế hệ AFM thứ ba, gồm nhiều biến thể server-side cho PCC. [Primary docs]
- **Kiến trúc "on-device nhỏ + private cloud cho phần nặng" của Apple chính là reference design** cho cách một monetization brain nên phân tầng trên iOS.
- **Ràng buộc kỹ thuật:** iOS không hỗ trợ LiteRT native cho production app theo cách Android làm — mô hình on-device trên iOS phải qua **Core ML**. Pipeline huấn luyện phải xuất **hai định dạng** (.tflite cho Android, Core ML cho iOS) từ cùng một kiến trúc; Apple quản lý việc chọn accelerator (Neural Engine/GPU/CPU), app chỉ đặt preference `computeUnits`. [Primary docs — Apple Core ML]
- Nghiên cứu 2024–2025 cho thấy nhiều app iOS vẫn bundle TFLite song song Core ML để giữ parity đa nền tảng — nhưng đường "chính chủ" vẫn là Core ML.

### B.3 On-device personalization (không cần FL đầy đủ)

- Kỹ thuật "local adapter / transfer learning 8-bit lượng tử hóa" trên thiết bị: giữ global model cố định, chỉ huấn luyện adapter nhỏ local theo user — cá nhân hóa on-device với chi phí rất thấp. [Primary research — JISEM 9/2025]
- Phù hợp cho giai đoạn sau của brain khi muốn cá nhân hóa sâu hơn mà không đưa thêm data về server.

## C. Federated Learning — đã production, nhưng chưa ai dùng cho monetization

### C.1 Hai deployment FL lớn nhất thế giới đều của OS vendor

- **Google Gboard:** FL + differential privacy cho language model của bàn phím, chạy production nhiều năm; paper chính thức "Federated Learning of Gboard Language Models with Differential Privacy" (ACL 2023 Industry, arXiv:2305.18465); cập nhật 2/2024 xác nhận tiếp tục đầu tư ("Advances in Private Training for Production On-Device Language Models"). [Primary research + Primary docs]
- **Apple Private Federated Learning (PFL):** dùng cho Siri, QuickType, Face ID, app-selection; framework nghiên cứu **pfl-research** đã open-source; case study "Private Federated Learning in Real World Application" (arXiv:2502.04565). [Primary research + Primary docs]
- **Android Privacy Sandbox** từng có API "On-Device Personalization / federated learning job" cho developer — nhưng với việc Privacy Sandbox bị khai tử 10/2025 (doc 13), tương lai API này không chắc chắn; phải coi FL là thứ **tự xây** trên nền LiteRT/Core ML, không phải thứ được platform cho sẵn.

### C.2 Gap quan trọng

- **Không tìm thấy production example nào của FL cho monetization/offer bandit.** Cả Gboard lẫn Apple PFL đều là prediction task giám sát (next-word, emoji…), không phải bài toán bandit với feedback phản thực.
- **Hệ quả:** FL là hướng đáng theo dõi cho giai đoạn privacy-siết-chặt, nhưng ở hiện tại (giữa 2026), **first-party server-side learning + on-device inference** là con đường thực dụng. Đưa FL vào roadmap Phase 4+ (doc 07), không đưa vào MVP.

## D. Kiến trúc hybrid: đâu on-device, đâu server

### D.1 Tiền lệ production: Adobe Target on-device decisioning

- Adobe Target có mode **on-device decisioning**: tải "rule artifact" (JSON chứa toàn bộ rule A/B/targeting) về cache, quyết định chạy in-memory gần 0-latency; mode **hybrid** (at.js 2.5+) quyết định tại device khi artifact đã cache, fallback về edge khi chưa. [Primary docs — Adobe Experience League]
- Đây là bằng chứng production rằng mô hình **"policy artifact + local evaluation + server fallback"** chạy được ở quy mô lớn — đúng pattern brain cần.

### D.2 Phân tầng đề xuất cho brain

```text
HOT PATH (tại decision point, <10ms, không network):
  - On-device bandit/GBDT (LiteRT / Core ML) chọn action
  - Guardrail engine chạy local (hard rules: cap, age-gate, doc 14)
  - Policy artifact cache (pattern Adobe Target)

WARM PATH (background, seconds–minutes):
  - Đồng bộ policy artifact mới; cập nhật feature local
  - On-device adapter update (mục B.3) khi đủ điều kiện sạc/idle

COLD PATH (server, offline):
  - Train lại policy; LTV model (doc 11)
  - LLM: sinh creative (A.1), mô phỏng kinh tế (A.3), phân tích (A.4)
  - A/B analysis, OPE (doc 05)
```

- **Fallback rule:** decision on-device thất bại/thiếu feature → fallback server; server cũng không kịp → default policy an toàn (NO_ACTION hoặc frequency tối thiểu). Không bao giờ block game frame chờ network.
- Firebase IAP optimization codelab (doc 08) là ví dụ mẫu của hướng on-device inference cho IAP — đáng đọc như tutorial nhập môn pattern này.

### D.3 Server-Driven UI — lớp trình diễn cho output của brain

- **Server-Driven UI (SDUI)** đã thành chuẩn production: **Airbnb Ghost Platform** (Sections/Screens, server gửi JSON mô tả UI, ship homepage redesign không qua app review), **Netflix Hawkins**, Lyft, Shopify, Nubank. [Primary engineering blogs / InfoQ]
- **Liên hệ với brain:** output của IAP_OFFER action không chỉ là "offer_id" mà có thể là **UI descriptor** (layout, copy variant, urgency framing) render bởi SDUI layer → thay đổi presentation không cần release app. Đây cũng là cách triển khai paywall A/B nhanh nhất.
- Lưu ý store policy: Apple cho phép SDUI trong phạm vi tính năng đã công bố; dùng SDUI để thay đổi flow thanh toán/giá có rủi ro review — presentation cá nhân hóa nên đi qua offer type hợp lệ (doc 13, Guidelines 3.1.x).

## E. Bảng tổng kết: dùng / không dùng

| Công nghệ | Slot | Hot path? | Ghi chú |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bandit/GBDT nhỏ (LiteRT/Core ML) | Quyết định action | ✅ | Xương sống |
| Policy artifact cache | Quyết định rule-based | ✅ | Pattern Adobe Target |
| LLM sinh creative | Thư viện creative offline | ❌ | HLLM-Creator pattern |
| LLM mô phỏng kinh tế | Dry-run chính sách | ❌ | Phải tiêm bias hành vi |
| Synthetic players | Red-team/guardrail test | ❌ | Không làm predictor |
| Gemini Nano / AFM on-device | Warm path, routing | ❌ | Chưa cho hot path |
| Federated Learning | Privacy-first training | ❌ | Chưa có tiền lệ monetization |
| SDUI | Trình diễn offer | — | Airbnb Ghost pattern |

# Final Compendium: Personalized Monetization Brain — Research Synthesis v17

**Date:** 2026-08-21  
**Round:** 6th sub-agent expansion (Market Trends + Behavioral ML Architecture + Economy & Ethics)  
**Purpose:** Single-source synthesis of all research across 18 files and ~150KB corpus

---

## 1. Executive Thesis (Integrated)

Monetization Brain la mot **decision platform** chon *next best monetization action* theo trang thai tung player va toi uu incremental long-term LTV. Khong phai ad SDK, khong phai IAP SDK, khong phai paywall renderer, khong phai dashboard segmentation.

**Luan diem then khoi da duoc cung co qua 6 rounds research:**
- AI/ML personalization da la table stakes cho top publishers (Bain 2026: 50%+ revenue/player lift tu AI LiveOps)
- Hybrid IAA/IAP model dang thang — Royal Match interstitial rollout thang 5/2026 la watershed moment
- Khoang trong thi truong ro nhat la **cross-monetization causal decisioning** — khong vendor nao public tron ven loop tu player state → IAA/IAP/no-action → uplift/bandit → guardrails → feedback
- Regulation (COPPA amendments Jan 2025, EU DFA, Sony $7.85M dynamic pricing settlement) tao co hoi product differentiation: "ethical guardrails" nhu first-class feature

---

## 2. Market & Competitive Intelligence

| **Dream Games** (Turkey) | Proprietary stack (secretive) | 80%+ Turkey mobile game revenue; puzzle/liveops specialist | [PocketGamer.biz](https://www.pocketgamer.biz/dream-games-and-peak-games-responsible-for-over-80-of-trkiyes-games-revenue/) |
| **Playrix** | AI creatives pivot | Content generation for UA + liveops adaptation | Industry reports 2025-2026 |

**Takeaway:** Top studios are building core ML systems internally while buying CRM/personalization tools. Open-sourcing ML papers (King) signals maturity — their tech is production-grade.

| EA mega-buyout | Part of $161B record M&A 2025 | Consolidation at publisher level |

### 2.4 The AI Cost Paradox

**Implication:** As UA gets more expensive, retention optimization via personalization becomes more valuable than UA acquisition. Monetization Brain's retention-focused reward function is more important than ever.

## 3. Player State Detection Architecture

### 3.1 Feature Computation at Scale: Reference Architectures

| Company | System | Scale | Tech Stack | Key Pattern |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Netflix** | Keystone + RDG | 1T events/day | Kafka + Flink + KStore | Event-time watermarks for out-of-order handling |
| **Spotify** | Scio/Beam + Feast | 1.4T data points/day, 700K events/sec | Beam + Dataflow + Cassandra + Redis | Unified batch+streaming; Feast integration |
| **Uber** | Michelangelo + Palette | 10T feature computations/day | Kafka + Flink + Pinot | Kappa+ architecture; single engine for real-time + historical |
| **Lyft** | Feature Service | Millions req/min, single-digit ms latency, 99.99% availability | Beam + Flink runner | Separates feature generation from model execution |

**Deployable options for Monetization Brain MVP:**
- **Feast** (open source): Used at Spotify, Gojek. Separate online/offline stores, point-in-time retrieval. Best for teams wanting control.
- **Tecton** (SaaS): Created by Feast creators. Native streaming features. Enterprise-ready.
- **Hopsworks** (Integrated MLOps): Full ML lifecycle. Built-in feature store.

**Flink Watermark Pattern (critical for gaming):**
```
Watermark(t) asserts: no more events with timestamp <= t will arrive.
Allowed lateness: windows stay open grace period after watermark, accepting late events via side outputs.
Per-key watermarks: reduce data loss (~33% data loss with global watermarks in certain keyed-stream scenarios).
```
Mobile clients go offline and batch-upload when connectivity resumes → watermarks + allowed lateness is mandatory.

### 3.2 Real-Time Player Segmentation Engines

**Industry Players:**

| Product | Latency | Signals | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **ironSource LevelPlay Dynamic Segmentation** | Real-time | Behavioral signals for ad targeting | Now Unity asset |
| **AppLovin AXON 2.0** | Sub-second | Rich player signals for ad pacing | Major growth driver since 2023; ad spend quadrupled |
| **Auxta** | Sub-0.2ms | Multi-dimensional behavioral vectors | Claims fastest in class |
| **GameAnalytics SegmentIQ** | Near-real-time | Behavioral grouping for A/B testing | Free tier available |

### 3.3 Hidden Markov Models for Player Sessions

**Canonical hidden states:**
| State | Observable Signals |
|---|---|
| Tutorial | Guided prompts, low failure rate, constrained actions |
| Exploration | High action variety, slow progression, many screen transitions |
| Flow | Steady improvement, consistent pacing, high completion |
| Frustration | Repeated failures, rapid retries, rage-quits, erratic input |
| Boredom | Declining input, idle periods, skipping content |
| Churn-risk | Decreasing frequency/session length, mid-session abandonment |
| Engagement peak | Extended sessions, high interaction density, social active, purchase triggers |

**Key academic references:**
- "Flow of the Game: HMM of Player Engagement" (SSRN 2021) — challenge level has positive but diminishing marginal effect
- RL-HMM for Decision-Making Dynamics (arXiv 2024)
- ACMTOMM Review: "Player Engagement Estimation" (2025) — comprehensive survey
- Frustration detection: 66.3%-83.1% accuracy from telemetry alone

### 3.4 Cold-Start Strategies

| Approach | Method | Success Uplift | Revenue Impact |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Transfer learning** | Meta-learned priors from similar games | +61.62% | -0.717% short-term |
| **Bayesian warm-start** | Hierarchical priors encoded across tasks | Moderate | Minimal |
| **Meta-learning exploration** (MELEE) | Learned exploration via imitation learning | Varies | TBD |

**Practical strategy:** Pre-train on related games, initialize Bayesian priors, start with best prior policy, rapidly adapt via Thompson Sampling.

### 3.5 Contextual Bandit Comparison

| Algorithm | Context-Aware | Sparse Rewards | Guardrail Support | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Epsilon-Greedy | No | Poor | Easy (blacklist) | Baseline only |
| UCB1 | No | Moderate | Moderate | Good baseline |
| **Thompson Sampling** | No | **Best (non-ctx)** | Good (constrained TS) | **Recommended non-ctx** |
| LinUCB | Yes (linear) | Moderate | Good | Strong with rich features |
| **LinTS (Bayesian CTX)** | Yes (linear) | **Best (ctx)** | **Best** | **Recommended overall** |
| Neural Bandits | Yes (non-linear) | Good | Emerging | SOTA for complex tasks |

**Production evidence:** TS achieved ~8% higher cumulative reward than LinUCB in 6-month production comparison (>500k decisions/day).

**Constrained bandit papers:** Meta AI (safety constraints), Amazon Science (CPO for CB), JMLR 2024 (stage-wise constraints).

**Deployable guardrail pattern:**
1. Use LinTS as base
2. Pre-filter removes arms violating hard constraints
3. Post-filter enforces budget via Lagrangian multiplier
4. Safety dashboard monitors violations with automatic fallback

---

## 4. Game Economy Anti-Patterns & Design Frameworks

### 4.1 Canonical Failure: Diablo Immortal (2022)

Launched June 2022 with Metacritic user score **0.8/10**. Max character ~$110,000. Earned $400M+ but lost 8.4M+ players. One whale spent $100K+ with no PvP matches at his power level.

**Root cause: Liquidity trap** — no economic bridge between whale and F2P tiers. Economy bifurcated.

**Lesson:** Monitor economy health metrics (whale-to-F2P ratio, marketplace participation, D7/D30 retention by spending tier). Auto-constrain actions that worsen bifurcation.

### 4.2 Known Anti-Patterns

| Anti-Pattern | Effect | Prevention Knob |
|---|---|---|
| Excessive free rewards → inflation | Currency oversupply | `free_value_daily_cap` |
| Energy walls behind paywalls | D7 retention drops 30-40% | Progressive difficulty relief |
| Hybrid IAA/IAP without design | Ads and IAP cannibalize | Economy-first design |
| Discount erosion | Train players never buy full-price | Min inter-sale intervals |
| Over-discount for sure things | Cannibalizes full-price conversion | Organic purchase probability gate |

### 4.3 Canonical Economy Design Frameworks

**Daniel Cook — Value Chains:** Faucets → Value chains → Drains. Balance equation: avg faucet = avg drain over time.

**Yodo1 — 4S Framework:** Sources, Sinks, Scarcity, Stability. "Scarcity and stability are where most economies actually break."

**Edward Castronova — Three Pillars:** Currency stability, price rationality, resource distribution.

**Currency types encoding:** Hard currency (near-zero free grant), soft currency (inflation monitoring), event currency (time-limited with expiry), social currency (anti-farming), prestige currency (increment only).

### 4.4 Sink Taxonomy

Progression, Engagement, Prestige, Gamble, Tax sinks. Each with distinct purpose and monitoring requirements.

---

## 5. Pricing, Regulations & Ethics

### 5.1 Sony Dynamic Pricing Scandal (2025-2026)

Nov 2025: Sony ran A/B pricing experiments showing different prices for identical games. By Mar 2026, covered 150+ games across 68 regions. Some games nearly doubled for certain users.

**Consequences:** US class action settlement $7.85M (May 2026); potential EU Directive 2011/83/EU violations; international lawsuits in UK/Netherlands/California; 2026 declared major enforcement year for algorithmic pricing globally.

**Why gaming harder than e-commerce:** Prices publicly shared within hours on Reddit/Discord; intense backlash and review bombs; gamers among most price-sensitive consumers; players actively game ML systems with alt accounts.

**Safe approach for MB:** Personalize offers (not prices), personalize currency grants (not item prices), optimize _when_ (not what price).

### 5.2 Global Loot Box Regulations

| Jurisdiction | Status | Key Detail |
|---|---|---|
| **Belgium** | Banned | Illegal gambling since 2018; fines up to EUR 800K |
| **Netherlands** | Regulated | Compliance rated "poor"; potential ban post-2026 |
| **UK** | Self-regulation failing | RSC found framework poorly enforced; PEGI 16 from Jun 2026 |
| **China** | Strict disclosure | Ban on login bonuses/first-spend incentives |
| **South Korea** | Enforced disclosure | Strong compliance |
| **Brazil** | Banned | Active ban since 2025 |

**Implementation:** Action Catalog must encode geo-fenced constraints, odds display, age-gated action subsets.

### 5.3 COPPA Amendments (Jan 2025)

- Separate opt-in consent before targeted advertising to children under 13
- No data monetization of children's personal information
- Loot box restrictions for minors under 16
- HoYoverse $20M FTC fine precedent (Jan 2025)

**Implementation:** Age verification before monetization actions; child-safe mode; documented parental consent chain.

### 5.4 EU Digital Fairness Act & Dark Patterns

- DFA explicitly targets dark patterns in video game monetization
- DSA Article 25 prohibits deceptive interfaces
- BEUC filed complaints against Roblox (2024)
- 59 known dark patterns mapped onto DSA categories
- EGDF 2025 guidance document for studios

### 5.5 Behavioral Economics as Policy Knobs

| Principle | Policy Knob | Constraint |
|---|---|---|
| Loss aversion | `loss_aversion_trigger` with caps | Max per session |
| Endowment effect | `trial_grant_duration` | No deception about permanence |
| Scarcity | `offer_duration_hours` | Genuine only; fake timers = dark pattern |
| Anchoring | `anchor_price_display` | Designer-visible toggle |
| Sunk cost | `progression_investment_display` | Opt-in/opt-out required |

**Design principle:** Explicit policy knobs with configurable constraints, NOT hidden ML parameters. ML optimizes within bounds.

---

## 6. How Previous Conclusions Changed

| Before | Updated With New Evidence |
|---|---|
| "Top publishers adopting AI" | Confirmed: Bain 2026 documents 50%+ lift; King published IAP timing paper; Scopely Playgami exists |
| "Hybrid IAA/IAP emerging" | Superseded: Royal Match (May 2026) makes it dominant |

| "Bandit algorithms" | Specified: LinTS recommended; TS for non-contextual; constrained TS variant |

## 7. What's Still Unknown

1. Offline RL evaluation methodology — Conservative Q-Learning/BCQ lack production case studies in game monetization
2. Cross-game transfer learning benchmarks — MELEE proven synthetically; need cross-publisher results
3. Economy simulation sandbox productization — Machinations.io does design-time only; Monte Carlo remains academic
4. Regional monetization psychology differences — Turkey success partly puzzle/liveops preferences but cross-cultural data sparse
5. Subscription vs microtransaction equilibrium — Cloud gaming 25% CAGR but MTX still 48% of PC revenue
6. AI NPC effects on player monetization — AI agents improve engagement patterns; impact on monetization unstudied

## 9. Bottom Line

Monetization Brain addresses a verified gap: **no vendor provides cross-monetization causal decisioning** from player state through IAA/IAP/no-action selection, causal uplift/bandit optimization, long-term LTV guardrails, and unified feedback.

Six rounds of sub-agent research across ~18 files have validated and deepened the thesis:
- Market validation: top publishers investing in AI LiveOps (50%+ lifts documented); Turkey shows model works at scale
- Technical validation: Flink+Feast at 1T+ events/day; HMM/RL-HMM published; constrained TS shows 8% improvement
- Economic validation: Diablo confirms liquidity trap risk; Machinations fills only design-time gap
- Regulatory tailwinds: COPPA amendments, EU DFA, pricing settlements create demand for "ethical-by-design" platforms

Next step: MVP build — rule-based DECIDE/FEEDBACK APIs + decision log + 3 decision points + rules/segments + A/B tests, before any ML rollout.

# 18 — Cuộc cách mạng kênh thanh toán: web shop, direct-to-player và hệ quả Epic/DMA

**Ngày nghiên cứu:** 2026-08-21

**Phạm vi:** Phân tích toàn diện về sự thay đổi cấu trúc lớn nhất trong monetization mobile giai đoạn 2024-2026: các vụ kiện Epic v. Apple/Google, EU Digital Markets Act, sự trỗi dậy của web shop và direct-to-player (D2P), cùng hệ quả đối với SDK monetization.

---

## 1. Epic v. Google: Từ phán quyết bồi thẩm đoàn đến settlement lịch sử

### 1.1 Phán quyết tháng 12/2023
Tháng 12/2023, bồi thẩm đoàn liên bang tại California tuyên bố Google là monopoly trong Android app distribution và in-app billing, vi phạm Sherman Act Section 2. [Primary docs — Jury Verdict Form, Epic v. Google, N.D. Cal. Dec 2023]

### 1.2 Remedies ruling tháng 10/2024
Thẩm phán James Donato ban hành injunction 3 năm với các điều khoản:
- **Sideloading bắt buộc**: Google phải cho phép cài đặt app từ bên ngoài Play Store
- **Alternative billing**: Developer được phép sử dụng hệ thống thanh toán riêng
- **No anti-steering**: Cấm Google ngăn developer hướng dẫn user đến kênh thanh toán khác

[Primary docs — Modified Injunction Order, Epic v. Google, N.D. Cal. Oct 2024]

### 1.3 Settlement proposal tháng 11/2025
Ngày 4-5/11/2025, Epic và Google công bố proposed settlement với các điều khoản:

**Fee reductions:**
- Standard in-app purchase fee giảm từ 30% xuống **20%**
- Subscription renewals: **~9-10%**
- Developers tham gia "Apps Experience Program": **15%** cho new installs

**$800 Million Side Deal:**
Trong hearings tháng 1/2026, một thỏa thuận bí mật trị giá **$800 triệu** giữa Epic và Google được tiết lộ, liên quan đến Unreal Engine licensing và services trong 6 năm. Judge Donato đặt câu hỏi về antitrust implications của deal này. [Primary research — Court hearing transcripts, Jan 2026]

**Third-party app stores:**
- "Registered App Stores" program cho phép qualified stores phân phối qua sideloading
- Fortnite quay lại Google Play toàn cầu

[Primary docs — Proposed Settlement, Epic v. Google, Nov 2025; Reuters 2025-11-05]

### 1.4 Revised settlement March 2026
Ngày 4/3/2026, Epic và Google đệ trình revised settlement agreement lên tòa án:

**Fee structure mới (áp dụng toàn cầu):**
- Service fee: **20%** (giảm từ 30%)
- Optional billing fee: **5%** cho apps sử dụng Google Play Billing
- **Tổng cộng**: 25% nếu dùng Google Play Billing, 20% nếu dùng alternative billing

[Primary docs — Revised Modified Injunction Motion, Epic v. Google, Mar 2026]

### 1.5 Withdrawal July 2026 và hậu quả
Ngày 15/7/2026, Epic và Google **jointly withdrew** motion to modify injunction, thay vì tiếp tục negotiate. Kết quả:

- **22/7/2026**: Third-party app stores bắt đầu xuất hiện **trực tiếp trong Google Play** (không chỉ qua sideloading)
- Các thay đổi về fee vẫn được implement theo kế hoạch
- Đây là sự mở cửa thực sự cho competition trong Android app distribution

[Primary docs — Joint Withdrawal Motion, July 2026; Ars Technica 2026-07]

---

## 2. Epic v. Apple: Supreme Court cert denial và enforcement battle

### 2.1 Timeline kiện tụng
- **Sep 2021**: Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers tuyên Apple vi phạm California Unfair Competition Law qua anti-steering rules, ban hành permanent injunction
- **Apr 2023**: Ninth Circuit affirm injunction
- **Jan 2024**: **US Supreme Court denies certiorari** — từ chối xem xét appeal của Apple [Primary docs — SCOTUS Order List, Jan 2024]

### 2.2 Anti-steering injunction enforcement
Injunction yêu cầu Apple cho phép developers include "buttons, external links, or other calls to action" hướng user đến alternative purchasing mechanisms ngoài app.

**Apple's initial response:**
- Cho phép external links nhưng áp **27% commission** (30% - 3%) trên web purchases
- Yêu cầu developers apply cho "External Purchase Link Entitlement"

[Primary docs — Apple Developer Program License Agreement, External Purchase Link Entitlement Addendum]

### 2.3 Contempt motion và willful violation finding
**April 2025**: Epic nộp contempt motion, cáo buộc Apple cố tình vi phạm injunction.

**May 8, 2025**: Judge Gonzalez Rogers ra ruling quan trọng:
- **Finding of willful violation**: "Apple willfully chose not to comply with the injunction's clear requirements"
- Court xác định Apple có **intent to create new anticompetitive barriers** qua 27% commission
- Referral cho possible criminal contempt proceedings
- Apple bị sanctioned for privilege abuse trong discovery process

[Primary docs — Order Re: Motion for Contempt, Epic v. Apple, N.D. Cal. May 8, 2025; Cravath news analysis]

### 2.4 US policy change: Zero commission on external links (May 2025)
Sau contempt ruling, Apple cập nhật policy:

**Từ May 2025, US App Store:**
- Developers có thể link users đến web checkout với **zero Apple commission**
- **No application process required** — tự động available cho tất cả US apps
- Developers giữ **100% revenue** từ web purchases

[Primary docs — Apple Developer Documentation: External Purchase, May 2025 update]

**Phạm vi áp dụng:**
- Chỉ áp dụng cho **US App Store storefront**
- Không áp dụng cho EU (có policy riêng theo DMA)
- Không áp dụng cho các regions khác

[Primary research — Developer implementation guides, May 2025]

### 2.5 Supreme Court cert on contempt (June 2026)
**May 6, 2026**: Supreme Court decline to pause contempt order pending appeal.

**June 30, 2026**: Trong diễn biến bất ngờ, Supreme Court **grants certiorari** trên Ninth Circuit's contempt ruling (Docket No. 25-1311, docketed May 27, 2026).

**Apple's argument:**
- Injunction chỉ nên áp dụng cho Epic Games, không phải "millions of other developers"
- Contempt finding quá harsh

**Current status (Aug 2026):** Supreme Court sẽ hear case trong term 2026-2027. Contempt order vẫn có hiệu lực trong khi chờ review.

[Primary docs — SCOTUS Docket No. 25-1311; Reuters 2026-05-06; IPWatchdog 2026-06-30]

---

## 3. EU Digital Markets Act: Enforcement và evolution 2024-2026

### 3.1 DMA có hiệu lực (March 2024)
**6/3/2024**: DMA bắt đầu có hiệu lực, designated Apple và Google là "gatekeepers" phải tuân thủ obligations.

**Apple's initial compliance (March 2024):**
- Cho phép **alternative app marketplaces** trên iOS trong EU
- Alternative payment processing với reduced commission
- **Core Technology Fee (CTF)**: €0.50 per install cho apps distributed outside App Store (chỉ áp dụng cho apps đạt "extraordinary scale")

[Primary docs — DMA Regulation (EU) 2022/1925; Apple Developer EU DMA Terms, Mar 2024]

### 3.2 European Commission fine €500M (April 2025)
**23/4/2025**: European Commission áp dụng **fines đầu tiên** dưới DMA:
- **Apple: €500 million**
- **Meta: €200 million**
- **Tổng cộng: €700 million**

**Apple's violation:**
- Restricting developers từ communicating với customers về alternative payment options
- Anti-steering provisions vi phạm DMA Article 5(4)
- Commission xác định Apple prevented developers from informing users về cheaper offers outside App Store

[Primary docs — European Commission Press Release IP/25/1905, Apr 23, 2025; Politico EU report]

**Apple's response:**
- **July 2025**: Apple appeals fine, gọi là "unprecedented" và "unfair"
- **July 8, 2026**: EU Court **rejects Apple's DMA challenge**, Apple loses gatekeeper appeal

[Primary docs — Apple Appeal Brief, Jul 2025; EU Court ruling Jul 2026; BBC/MacRumors reports]

### 3.3 Policy evolution: From CTF to CTC (June 2025)
**June 26, 2025**: Apple announces sweeping changes cho apps trong EU:

**Fee structure mới:**
1. **Initial Acquisition Fee**: 2%
2. **Store Services Fee**: 5-13% (tùy category)
3. **Core Technology Commission (CTC)**: 5% cho apps trên StoreKit External Purchase Link Entitlement (EU) Addendum

**Timeline:**
- **Until Dec 31, 2025**: Apps under Alternative Terms Addendum chỉ chịu CTF
- **From Jan 1, 2026**: Transition to single business model — CTF replaced by CTC
- CTC áp dụng cho digital goods/services sold qua App Store, Web Distribution, hoặc Alternative Marketplaces

[Primary docs — Apple Developer News, Jun 26, 2025; Alternative EU Terms Addendum]

### 3.4 Communication and promotion of offers (June 2025)
Developers trong EU storefronts có thể:
- **Communicate và promote offers** cho digital goods/services
- Link đến destinations tùy chọn (websites, alternative marketplaces, other apps)
- Access methods: outside app, in-app web view, hoặc native experience

[Primary docs — Apple Developer Support: Communication and promotion of offers in EU]

### 3.5 August 2026 updates: Further simplification
**August 2026**: Apple announces thêm changes:
- **Eliminated CTF hoàn toàn** — replaced by 5% CTC trên digital goods/services revenue
- Expanded eligibility cho operating alternative app marketplaces
- **Effective minimum rate**: ~7% achievable through Web Distribution hoặc alternative marketplace
- Cho phép developers offer Apple IAP **alongside** alternative payment options (trước đây không permitted)

[Primary docs — Apple Newsroom Aug 2026; TechCrunch 2026-08-18]

### 3.6 Developer adoption statistics
**Adoption rates (2024-2026):**
- Apple estimated **<1% of developers** sẽ pay CTF (suggesting very low uptake)
- Alternative app stores account for **~5% EU market** sau 2 năm
- **Handful of alternative stores** launched: AltStore PAL (Apr 2024), SideStore, gaming-focused platforms
- Mainstream adoption còn limited

[Secondary — Industry adoption surveys, Apple estimates, 2024-2026]

**Studies cited by Apple:**
- DMA led to **worse consumer experiences** (less security, privacy)
- **Failed to lower App Store prices** as intended

[Secondary — Apple DMA impact report, Sep 2025; MacRumors Nov 2025]

---

## 4. Google Play billing changes: User choice và fee restructuring

### 4.1 User Choice Billing program (2024-2025)
Google introduced **User Choice Billing** pilot, later expanded:
- Users có thể choose giữa **Google Play Billing** hoặc **alternative billing system** tại checkout
- Developers phải integrate cả hai options side-by-side
- **4% fee reduction** khi users chọn alternative billing (từ 15% xuống 11% cho revenue under $1M annually)

**Rollout:**
- UK: March 2025
- EEA, US: expanded throughout 2025-2026

[Primary docs — Google Play Console Help: User Choice Billing; Google Blog EEA update]

### 4.2 Expanded billing choice (June 30, 2026)
**June 30, 2026**: Google announces major changes, effective immediately in US, UK, EEA:

**Fee structure mới:**
- **Service Fee**: 10% trên first $1M USD annual earnings (tất cả auto-renewing subscriptions)
- **Billing Fee**: 5% (optional, chỉ nếu dùng Google Play Billing)
- **Total**: 15% nếu dùng Google Play Billing, 10% nếu dùng alternative billing

**Separation principle:**
- Google tách service fee (platform access) khỏi billing fee (payment processing)
- Developers không dùng Google Play Billing chỉ trả 10% service fee

[Primary docs — Android Developers Blog: Expanded billing choice, Jun 30, 2026; Google Play Support]

### 4.3 Apps Experience Program
- **15% service fee** cho new user acquisitions qua Play Store
- Incentivize developers drive new installs
- Eligibility criteria chưa công bố chi tiết

[Secondary — Industry analysis of Apps Experience Program, 2026]

### 4.4 Subscription-specific changes
- Auto-renewing subscriptions: **10% service fee** (down from previous tiered structure)
- Subscription renewals không còn 30%/15% tiered
- Applies regardless of billing method used

[Primary docs — Google Play Subscription Fees Update, Jun 2026]

### 4.5 Small Business Program (continuing)
- **15% service fee** cho developers earning under $1M annually
- Program vẫn tồn tại song song với new fee structure
- Developers có thể choose whichever is more favorable

[Primary docs — Google Play Small Business Program terms]

## 5. Web shop / Direct-to-Player economics: The $17B market

### 5.1 Market size và growth
**2025 data:**
- Global D2C/web shop market: **~$17 billion** (15% of total IAP revenue)
- D2C revenue grew **26%** ở US, trong khi overall mobile game revenue flat (+0.2%)
- Share of top-grossing games với web shops: **44%** (quadrupled từ 12% trong 5 năm)
- Top 100 titles: D2C earnings grew **38%** trong 2025

[Secondary — Appcharge Research, Jun 2026; Newzoo, PocketGamer.biz reports]

**2026 projections:**
- Global IAP market: **$121.1 billion** (Newzoo)
- D2C segment tiếp tục grow 25-35% annually

### 5.2 Fee arbitrage math
**Traditional app store model:**
- Gross revenue: $100
- Platform fee (30%): -$30
- Payment processing (included): $0
- **Net to developer: $70 (70%)**

**Web shop model:**
- Gross revenue: $100
- Payment processing (Stripe, ~2.9% + $0.30): -$3.20
- Vendor fee (Appcharge/Xsolla ~5%): -$5
- **Net to developer: ~$91.80 (91.8%)**

**Savings:** ~$21.80 per $100 (31% improvement)

[Primary research — Fee structure calculations based on published rates]

### 5.3 Case studies: Major studios

#### Scopely — Monopoly Go!
- **$6 billion** lifetime IAP revenue (2025) — fastest mobile game to reach milestone (~1,275 days)
- Monopoly Go Store giúp drive **$5+ billion** trong revenue
- D2C strategy được industry analysts đánh giá là "most successful practitioner"
- Only ~20% revenue từ newer players → strong reliance on established D2C player bases

[Primary research — Scopely announcements, Sensor Tower data; Case study — Stash.gg analysis]

#### Supercell
- **2025 revenue**: €2.65 billion ($3 billion), down 4% YoY
- EBITDA: €932 million (+6%)
- Operates **Supercell Store** (proprietary web shop)
- **Important note**: Public revenue estimates (Sensor Tower) **do not include** Supercell Store purchases → actual total revenue có thể cao hơn reported
- Five trong six live games đều surpass $1 billion revenue
- Clash Royale là biggest contributor 2025

[Primary research — Supercell official results, Feb 2026; Case study — Stash.gg Supercell Store analysis]

#### Playrix
- **2025 IAP revenue**: ~$1.5 billion
- Led by Gardenscapes ($442.1M), Homescapes, Township, Fishdom
- **$12+ billion** cumulative revenue từ founding
- Ad-supported revenue streams (Pangle partnership) raised monthly revenue by 28%
- Specific D2C percentage chưa disclosed publicly

[Primary research — Playrix revenue reports; Statista data]

### 5.4 Infrastructure vendors landscape

#### Appcharge
**Headquarters:** Tel Aviv (offices: Helsinki, London, Seoul)
**Core offering:**
- Direct-to-consumer web stores
- Global payments (200+ methods)
- Gamified offers cho mobile games

**SDK capabilities:**
- **iOS Payments SDK** (released Jun 2025) — external payment links anywhere trong iOS games
- iOS, Android, Unity, WebGL Checkout
- Mobile-optimized checkout via payment links
- Region/device/payment-aware adaptive checkout
- Claimed **92% conversion rates**

**Market position:**
- Named 2026 Game Changer (Lightspeed/GamesBeat)
- Reported **$700M+** trong DTC transactions
- Led $17Bn market research

[Primary research — Appcharge press releases, BusinessWire Jun 2026; Appcharge.com]

#### Xsolla
**Background:** 20+ years trong game commerce, **$10B+** total processed
**Core offering:**
- Branded D2C storefronts
- 200+ payment methods
- LiveOps promotions
- First-party player data ownership

**SDK v3.1 (Mar 2026):**
- Single centralized commerce layer across mobile, PC, web
- New Unity SDK (Aug 2025) for D2C monetization
- Link-out từ games to web shops (enabled in US)
- Buy Button for mobile games
- Dynamic web shop personalization via real-time in-game data webhooks

**Fees:** ~5% royalties

[Primary research — Xsolla SDK documentation, BusinessWire Mar 2026; Xsolla.com]

#### Stripe + Unity Commerce
**October 2025:** Unity launches native cross-platform commerce management
- Partnership với Stripe cho payment processing
- Unified digital stores across mobile, web, PC directly trong Unity Engine
- 125+ local payment methods
- Link for fast checkout
- Tax, fraud, dispute management

[Primary research — Unity investor relations Oct 2025; Stripe gaming solutions]

#### Other vendors
- **Stash.gg**: Analytics + D2C optimization
- **FastSpring**: Merchant of Record solutions
- **Paddle**: Payment infrastructure
- **Nexway**: Alternative to Xsolla

[Secondary — Industry vendor comparisons, 2026]

### 5.5 Adoption challenges và countermeasures

#### Cross-channel entitlement verification
**Technical complexity:**
- Server-side must track purchases across multiple channels (App Store, Google Play, web shop)
- Prevent double-spending hoặc fraud
- Maintain single source of truth cho player inventory
- Handle subscription portability (user switches từ iOS to web)

**Solutions:**
- Unified player account systems
- Server-side purchase receipt validation APIs
- Cross-platform entitlement databases

[Primary research — Technical implementation patterns]

#### Apple/Google countermeasures
**Apple's response:**
- Initially 27% commission on external links (reduced to zero in US May 2025)
- EU: 5% CTC trên web purchases
- User experience friction (warning dialogs, extra steps)

**Google's response:**
- User Choice Billing: force developers show both options side-by-side
- Reduced but not eliminated fees (10-15% vs 30%)
- Apps Experience Program: incentivize stay trong Play ecosystem

[Primary research — Platform policy analysis]

#### Marketing và discovery challenges
- Driving users to web shop requires marketing spend
- In-app link-out restrictions (historically)
- Conversion funnel optimization
- User trust in non-platform payment flows

[Secondary — Developer experience surveys, 2025-2026]

## 6. Implications cho SDK monetization (2026+)

### 6.1 Multi-channel purchase routing
**Requirement:** SDK phải support flexible routing logic:
- Detect user location (US, EU, other)
- Determine available payment channels per platform policy
- Route to optimal channel based on:
  - Fee optimization (lowest cost)
  - User preference
  - Conversion likelihood
  - Compliance requirements

**Implementation:**
```typescript
interface PurchaseRouter {
  routeToChannel(product: Product, user: User): PurchaseChannel;
}

type PurchaseChannel =
  | { type: 'app_store'; billing: 'iap' }
  | { type: 'google_play'; billing: 'play_billing' | 'alternative' }
  | { type: 'web_shop'; url: string; vendor: 'xsolla' | 'appcharge' | 'stripe' }
```

### 6.2 Receipt validation across channels
**Challenge:** Each channel có receipt format và validation mechanism khác nhau:
- **Apple IAP**: StoreKit receipt, server-side validation via Apple's API
- **Google Play**: Developer API verification
- **Web shop**: Vendor-specific (Stripe webhook, Xsolla callback, etc.)

**SDK architecture:**
- Unified receipt validation interface
- Channel-specific adapters
- Server-side verification service
- Fraud detection layer

```typescript
interface ReceiptValidator {
  validate(receipt: PurchaseReceipt): Promise<ValidationResult>;
}

interface PurchaseReceipt {
  channel: 'app_store' | 'google_play' | 'web_shop';
  transactionId: string;
  rawReceipt: string;
  vendor?: string; // for web_shop
}
```

### 6.3 Subscription portability
**Use case:** User mua subscription trên web shop, sau đó login trên iOS device → phải recognize entitlement.

**Requirements:**
- Centralized subscription state management
- Cross-device, cross-platform sync
- Graceful handling of platform-specific subscription lifecycle events
- Migration paths (iOS subscription → web subscription và ngược lại)

**Data model:**
```typescript
interface Subscription {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  product: Product;
  channel: PurchaseChannel;
  status: 'active' | 'expired' | 'cancelled';
  expiresAt: Date;
  platformSpecificData?: {
    appStoreSubscriptionId?: string;
    playStoreSubscriptionId?: string;
  };
}
```

### 6.4 Web shop deep linking và in-app browser
**User experience optimization:**
- Deep link từ app đến web shop (với tracking parameters)
- In-app browser (WebView) để giữ user trong app context
- Custom URL schemes cho return flow
- Deep link attribution để track conversion

**Implementation considerations:**
- iOS: Universal Links hoặc custom URL schemes
- Android: App Links
- Web shop URL parameters: `user_id`, `session_token`, `utm_source=app`

### 6.5 Server-side entitlement system
**Architecture:**
- **Entitlement service**: Single source of truth cho user purchases
- **Purchase ingestion**: Webhooks từ all channels (App Store, Google Play, web vendors)
- **Entitlement API**: Game server queries để unlock content
- **Reconciliation**: Handle edge cases (refunds, chargebacks, subscription lapses)

**Key components:**
```typescript
interface EntitlementService {
  grantEntitlement(userId: string, productId: string, source: PurchaseChannel): void;
  checkEntitlement(userId: string, productId: string): boolean;
  revokeEntitlement(userId: string, productId: string, reason: string): void;
}
```

### 6.6 Compliance và policy adherence
**Dynamic policy engine:**
- Track policy changes across regions (US, EU, UK, etc.)
- Automatic compliance checks before enabling features
- Logging và audit trail cho regulatory requests

**Example policy rules (2026):**
- US iOS: External links allowed, zero commission
- EU iOS: Alternative payment allowed, 5% CTC
- US Android: Alternative billing allowed, 20% service fee
- EU Android: User choice billing, 10-15% total

### 6.7 Analytics và optimization
**Metrics to track:**
- Channel mix (percentage revenue từ each channel)
- Conversion rates by channel
- Fee savings từ D2C routing
- User retention và LTV by acquisition channel
- Subscription churn by platform

**A/B testing framework:**
- Test different channel routing strategies
- Optimize web shop pricing (pass savings to users vs keep margin)
- Measure impact of platform UX friction (warning dialogs)

## Không xác minh được (ghi rõ)

1. **Fortnite web shop specific revenue**: Epic chưa publicly disclose doanh số cụ thể từ Fortnite web shop / D2P channel. Các số liệu revenue chỉ bao gồm Epic Games Store tổng thể ($1.16B năm 2025).

2. **Exact percentage of revenue from web shops**: Các studios lớn (Scopely, Supercell, Playrix) chưa tiết lộ chính xác bao nhiêu % revenue đến từ web shop vs app store. Các ước tính là từ industry analysts.

3. **Apple's future US commission structure**: Sau Supreme Court cert grant (Jun 2026), chưa rõ liệu Apple sẽ áp dụng commission nào cho external links trong tương lai nếu họ thắng appeal.

4. **Google Apps Experience Program details**: Eligibility criteria và fee structure chi tiết chưa được Google công bố đầy đủ.

5. **EU alternative marketplace adoption numbers**: Số liệu chính xác về bao nhiêu developers đã adopt alternative distribution trong EU chưa được Apple hoặc Commission công bố. Các ước tính "<1%" là từ Apple's own projections.

**Kết luận:** Giai đoạn 2024-2026 chứng kiến sự sụp đổ của mô hình "walled garden" 30% commission. SDK monetization hiện đại phải là multi-channel platform, hỗ trợ flexible routing, cross-platform entitlement, và dynamic policy compliance. Cơ hội cho developers là rất lớn: tiết kiệm 20-25% fee, sở hữu first-party data, và kiểm soát trực tiếp player relationship. Tuy nhiên, complexity tăng đáng kể, đòi hỏi sophisticated backend infrastructure và continuous policy monitoring.

# 19 — Bộ tính năng paywall & subscription mà thế giới đang áp dụng

**Ngày nghiên cứu:** 2026-08-21
**Phạm vi:** Toàn bộ feature set của lớp paywall/subscription SDK (RevenueCat, Adapty, Superwall, Apphud, Purchasely, Qonversion, và các vendor nhỏ hơn); platform features của App Store & Google Play 2025–2026 mà các SDK này wrap; góc nhìn gaming-specific (battle pass, VIP, season pass); và checklist tính năng mà SDK của chúng ta cần match hoặc vượt.

## Evidence labels

- **[Primary docs]**: docs/website chính thức của vendor hoặc Apple/Google developer documentation.

## A. Bức tranh vendor & mức độ phổ biến

### A.1 Tier 1 — RevenueCat (market leader)

- **Quy mô:** 50,000+ apps đang sử dụng; 115,000+ apps trong dataset benchmark; $16B revenue tracked; 1B+ transactions processed. [Case study — self-reported: RevenueCat State of Subscription Apps 2026]
- **Pricing:** Free tới $2,500 Monthly Tracked Revenue (MTR); trên ngưỡng đó tính 1% của phần vượt. Không có seat license hay per-user fee. [Primary docs — revenuecat.com/pricing]
- **Platform support:** iOS, Android, Web (Stripe), Amazon, Roku — entitlements sync xuyên nền tảng. [Primary docs — revenuecat.com]
- **Tính năng nổi bật:** Paywall Builder v2 (SwiftUI / Jetpack Compose native, WYSIWYG, AI translations, multi-screen flows); Experiments (A/B test tối đa 4 variant, equal weight, 24h data delay); Fraud Protection; Customer Management; 30+ integrations (Amplitude, Braze, Segment, Mixpanel, AppsFlyer, Adjust, Slack…). [Primary docs — revenuecat.com/features; revenuecat.com/changelog]
- **Điểm yếu:** A/B test chỉ 4 variant, equal split, data delay 24h — bị coi là hạn chế so với Adapty/Superwall cho experimentation nâng cao. [Secondary — PkgPulse, BuildMVPFast so sánh 2026]
- **Ai dùng:** Dominant trong giới utility/productivity/fitness/education subscription apps. Game studios lớn ít dùng vì họ đã có backend IAP riêng.

### A.2 Tier 1 — Adapty (fastest growing challenger)

- **Quy mô:** 16,000+ apps trong dataset benchmark; $3B subscription revenue analyzed; 500,000 transaction events; 105,000 paywalls analyzed. [Case study — self-reported: Adapty State of In-App Subscriptions 2026]
- **Pricing (mới 2026):** Free toàn bộ tính năng tới $5,000 monthly revenue; trên ngưỡng đó 1% revenue. Bao gồm tất cả add-ons (Refund Saver, Apple Ads Manager). [Primary docs — adapty.io/blog/adapty-new-pricing-2026]
- **Platform support:** iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Unity, Web. [Primary docs — adapty.io]
- **Tính năng nổi bật:** No-code Paywall Builder; A/B testing không giới hạn variant và traffic split; Predictive Analytics (LTV prediction); Paywall Library (10,000+ real-world paywall screens từ top apps); Revenue Analytics chi tiết; Receipt Validation server-side; Rules engine tự động hóa subscription workflows. [Primary docs — adapty.io]
- **Báo cáo benchmark:** "State of In-App Subscriptions 2026" — 95% revenue thuộc top 10% apps; 44.5% users reject paywall ở thời điểm nào đó; European users trả nhiều hơn cho subscription apps. [Case study — self-reported: adapty.io/state-of-in-app-subscriptions]
- **Ai dùng:** Phổ biến cả apps lẫn một số game studios (có Unity SDK). Đang tăng trưởng nhanh trong giới indie và mid-tier.

### A.3 Tier 2 — Superwall (paywall-first experimentation platform)

- **Vị trí:** Tập trung vào lớp presentation/experimentation (paywall builder + A/B test + campaigns), thường được dùng **kết hợp** RevenueCat/Adapty cho subscription infrastructure. [Secondary — buildmvpfast.com, pkgpulse.com]
- **Pricing:** Free tới $10,000 Monthly Attributed Revenue (MAR) — chỉ tính revenue từ paywall, không tính toàn bộ app revenue; 250 conversions/tháng free, $0.20/conversion vượt; subscription infrastructure (entitlements, webhooks, SQL access) free ở mọi scale. Startup $49/mo + 1% MAR; Growth $199/mo + 1% MAR. [Primary docs — superwall.com/pricing; superwall.com/blog/superwalls-new-pricing]
- **Tính năng nổi bật:** Visual Paywall Editor; Campaigns & trigger rules (khi nào hiện paywall cho user nào); A/B testing không giới hạn variant; Surveys; Localization; AI-powered features; SQL data access. [Primary docs — superwall.com/features]
- **Điểm mạnh:** Pricing model chỉ charge trên revenue paywall tạo ra (attributed), không phải toàn bộ MTR. Rất hấp dẫn cho apps đã có RevenueCat. [Secondary]
- **Ai dùng:** Chủ yếu utility/lifestyle/subscription apps; indie devs.

### A.4 Tier 2 — Apphud

- **Vị trí:** All-in-one growth infrastructure cho subscription apps; open-source SDKs. [Primary docs — apphud.com]

- **Điểm mạnh:** Free tier hào phóng nhất ($10K MTR); open-source SDKs; 99.9% uptime claim. [Primary docs]

Airbridge là MMP (attribution/measurement), Purchasely là paywall/subscription SDK — hai lớp khác nhau. [Nghiên cứu này xác minh qua StartupIntros, Tracxn, LinkedIn Purchasely — không có record acquisition nào.]

## B. Bộ tính năng chuẩn mà thế giới đã standardize

### B.1 No-code / Remote-configured Paywall Builder

Tất cả Tier 1 & Tier 2 vendors đều cung cấp:
- **Visual/WYSIWYG editor** cho paywall screens (Adapty, Superwall, RevenueCat v2, Purchasely, Qonversion 2.0). [Primary docs]
- **Remote configuration:** thay đổi paywall content, pricing display, copy, images mà không cần app release. [Primary docs]
- **Multi-screen flows:** onboarding → feature intro → social proof → paywall (Blinkist-style). [Secondary — RevenueCat blog]
- **Native rendering:** SwiftUI (iOS) + Jetpack Compose (Android) — không phải WebView. [Primary docs — RevenueCat Paywall Builder v2]
- **AI-powered translations:** RevenueCat v2 có built-in AI translation. [Primary docs]
- **Template libraries:** Adapty có 10,000+ real-world paywall screens; Superwall có curated templates. [Primary docs]

**Status:** Đây là table stakes 2026. Không có vendor nào thiếu tính năng này.

### B.2 Paywall Placement & Trigger Rules

- **Campaign-based triggers:** Superwall cho phép define "campaigns" — rules xác định khi nào và cho ai hiện paywall (ví dụ: sau 3 sessions, sau khi dùng feature X, sau N ngày). [Primary docs — superwall.com/features/campaigns]
- **Rules engine:** Adapty và Apphud có rules engine tự động hóa workflows dựa trên subscriber events. [Primary docs]
- **Placement flexibility:** paywall có thể được trigger từ nhiều điểm trong app (onboarding completion, feature gate, settings, inline prompt). [Primary docs]

### B.3 A/B Testing & Multivariate Testing

| Vendor | Variant limit | Traffic split | Data delay | Statistical engine |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **RevenueCat** | 4 variants | Equal only | 24h | Built-in confidence |
| **Adapty** | Unlimited | Flexible % | Real-time | Built-in |
| **Superwall** | Unlimited | Flexible | Real-time | Built-in |
| **Qonversion** | Unlimited | Flexible | Real-time | Confidence stats built-in |
| **Apphud** | Multiple | — | — | — |

[Primary docs từ mỗi vendor; Secondary — pkgpulse.com, buildmvpfast.com so sánh 2026]

**Testing scope:** Không chỉ paywall design mà còn: pricing tiers, copy/CTA, images, offer types (free trial vs. discount vs. hard paywall), onboarding flows, placement timing. [Primary docs]

### B.4 Onboarding & Trial-flow Optimization

- **Onboarding-to-paywall flow:** Multi-screen sequence giới thiệu app value trước khi hiện paywall. RevenueCat v2 hỗ trợ native multi-screen flows. [Primary docs]
- **Trial eligibility detection:** SDK tự động detect user có eligible cho introductory offer / free trial hay không (dựa trên subscription history của Apple/Google). [Primary docs — Apple StoreKit, Google Play Billing]
- **Trial conversion tracking:** Tất cả vendors track trial → paid conversion rate. [Primary docs]
- **Adapty finding:** 44.5% users reject paywall — nhấn mạnh cần optimize onboarding flow trước paywall. [Case study — self-reported: Adapty 2026]

### B.5 Introductory Offers & Free Trial Logic

**App Store (iOS):**
- **Introductory Offers:** free trial hoặc discounted price cho new/first-time subscribers; configure trong App Store Connect; StoreKit API `isEligibleForIntroOffer` tự động check eligibility. [Primary docs — developer.apple.com/documentation/storekit/implementing-introductory-offers-in-your-app]
- **Promotional Offers:** discounted price cho existing active subscribers (để reduce churn). [Primary docs]
- **Offer Codes:** single-use (18-char unique) hoặc reusable; max 10 active offers/subscription; 1,000,000 redemptions/app/quarter. Apple đã **khai tử traditional promo codes cho IAP từ 26/03/2026**, chuyển hoàn toàn sang offer code system. [Primary docs — developer.apple.com; Secondary — super-apps.ai]
- **Win-Back Offers (WWDC 2024):** free/discounted offer cho churned/lapsed subscribers — configure trong App Store Connect; chỉ hiện cho users đã cancel subscription. [Primary docs — developer.apple.com/documentation/storekit/supporting-win-back-offers-in-your-app; WWDC24 session 10110]

**Google Play:**
- **Free Trial:** configure trên base plan hoặc offer; Google tự track eligibility. [Primary docs — developer.android.com/google/play/billing/subscriptions]
- **Introductory Pricing:** discounted price cho first billing period. [Primary docs]
- **Promotions:** configure trong Play Console. [Primary docs]

**SDK wrapping:** Tất cả Tier 1 SDKs wrap logic này — SDK tự detect eligibility, hiển thị đúng offer cho đúng user, handle redemption flow. [Primary docs]

### B.6 Price Localization & Elasticity Experiments

- **Apple Price Tiers:** App Store hỗ trợ 900+ price points across 175 regions; auto-convert từ base price. [Primary docs]
- **PPP (Purchasing Power Parity) pricing:** Xu hướng mạnh 2025–2026 — điều chỉnh giá theo sức mua địa phương. Mirava.io report: PPP adjustments có thể tăng revenue 15–122% trong 1 tháng cho subscription apps. PPP Price Planner app (Apple App Store) tự động localize cho 175+ countries. [Secondary — mirava.io; subscriptionindex.com]
- **Elasticity experiments:** RevenueCat blog có hướng dẫn chi tiết "A/B Price Testing Guide for Mobile Apps" — test nhiều price points đồng thời để tìm optimal pricing. Adapty cũng hỗ trợ price A/B testing. [Primary docs — revenuecat.com/blog/engineering/mobile-app-a-b-price-testing-guide]
- **Regional pricing benchmarks:** Adapty State of In-App Subscriptions 2026 report có LTV data theo category và region. [Case study — self-reported]

### B.7 Billing Failure Recovery / Dunning

**Apple App Store:**
- **Billing Grace Period:** configurable period (developer set) mà subscriber vẫn access content khi payment fail; Apple retry charge trong thời gian này. [Primary docs — developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-subscriptions/enable-billing-grace-period]
- **Billing Retry Period:** Apple tự động retry payment trong **60 ngày** kể từ failure date. [Primary docs — developer.apple.com/documentation/storekit/reducing-involuntary-subscriber-churn]

**Google Play:**
- **Grace Period:** lên tới 30 ngày; **enabled by default** trên tất cả auto-renewing base plans; user vẫn access subscription. Google retry payment trong grace period. [Primary docs — developer.android.com/google/play/billing/lifecycle/subscriptions]
- **Account Hold:** sau grace period nếu payment vẫn fail → subscription vào account hold → user **mất entitlement**; từ **12/2025**, default duration = 60 ngày trừ grace period length (ví dụ grace 7 ngày → account hold ~53 ngày). Developer có thể adjust/disable từ Play Console. [Primary docs — support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/16631229]
- **Real-time Developer Notifications (RTDN):** recommended để detect grace period & account hold transitions. [Primary docs]

**SDK dunning features:**
- RevenueCat, Adapty track billing retry status và expose qua webhook/API. [Primary docs]
- Best practice industry: variable retry schedule (3→5→7 ngày), 4–8 attempts trong 15–30 ngày, smart dunning (proactively refresh expiring cards). 58% failed payments recovered qua smart retry scheduling. Subscription businesses mất ~9% MRR vì failed payments. [Secondary — Recurly 2025, Chargebee, Solidgate]

### B.8 Win-back Offers & Churned-subscriber Discounts

- **Apple Win-Back Offers (WWDC 2024):** targeted free/discounted offers cho lapsed subscribers; configure trong App Store Connect; chỉ hiện cho users đã churn. [Primary docs — WWDC24 session 10110; developer.apple.com]
- **Google Play:** không có native "win-back offer" tương đương; developer phải tự implement logic (detect churned user, show custom offer). [Primary docs]
- **RevenueCat & Adapty:** track win-back offer performance; RevenueCat có beginner's guide chi tiết. [Primary docs — revenuecat.com/blog/growth/guide-to-apple-win-back-offers]
- **Email/push win-back sequences:** Airbridge blog hướng dẫn build win-back email sequences kết hợp subscription data. [Secondary — airbridge.io]

### B.9 Refund & Chargeback Handling

- **Adapty Refund Saver:** feature đặc biệt giúp retain subscriber sau refund bằng cách offer alternative plan/discount. [Primary docs — adapty.io]
- **Apple/Google refund notifications:** Cả hai platform gửi server notification khi refund xảy ra; SDK wrap logic này để update entitlement. [Primary docs]
- **Chargeback tracking:** RevenueCat fraud protection tự động detect suspicious refund patterns. [Primary docs]

### B.10 Subscription Groups / Upgrades / Downgrades

**App Store:**
- **Subscription Groups:** organize related subscriptions; ranking order determines upgrade/downgrade/cross-grade paths. Upgrade = billed immediately + prorated refund; Downgrade = stay on current plan until next billing cycle; Cross-grade = equal-tier seamless switch. Apple tự động manage billing adjustments. [Primary docs — developer.apple.com/app-store/subscriptions; adapty.io/blog/app-store-subscription-groups]

**Google Play:**
- **Base plans + product change config:** không dùng "groups" giống iOS; developer configure "update policy" cho mỗi plan change (immediate charge vs. at renewal). [Primary docs — developer.android.com/google/play/billing/subscriptions]
- **I/O 2026:** Subscription Management API mới cho phép offer cheaper alternatives để retain users thay vì cancel — aimed at reducing cancellations. [Conference — Google I/O 2026; Secondary — androidheadlines.com 05/2026]

**SDK wrapping:** RevenueCat, Adapty, Qonversion đều expose API cho upgrade/downgrade flow, tự động handle proration logic. [Primary docs]

### B.11 Family Sharing

- **Apple Family Sharing:** up to 6 people share subscriptions (developer opt-in). [Primary docs — support.apple.com/en-us/105062]
- **WWDC 2026 — Group Subscriptions (Multi-Seat Plans):** một user invite others share access — mở rộng hơn Family Sharing truyền thống (không giới hạn family group). [Conference — WWDC26 session 210; Secondary — macrumors.com 06/2026]
- **Google Play:** không có native family sharing cho third-party subscriptions. [Primary docs]

### B.12 Cross-platform Entitlement Sync (iOS/Android/Web)

Đây là **pain point lớn nhất** mà tất cả Tier 1 vendors giải quyết:

- **RevenueCat:** unified entitlement layer across iOS, Android, Web (Stripe), Amazon, Roku. Single customer profile sync subscription state xuyên platform. Blog chi tiết "Cross-platform subscription state" (02/2026). [Primary docs — revenuecat.com/blog/engineering/cross-platform-subscription]
- **Adapty:** Data Synchronization Across Platforms — sync subscription state across iOS, Android, Stripe, any provider via web API. [Primary docs — adapty.io/subscription-sync]
- **Qonversion:** cross-platform SDK (iOS/Android/Web JS) — integrate once, entitlement sync tự động. [Primary docs — qonversion.io/subscription-management]
- **Challenge:** StoreKit không biết gì về Android/web; mỗi platform có purchase model riêng; user có thể double-pay hoặc churn nếu subscription không được recognize khi đổi device. [Secondary — appsops.store, auditbuffet.com]

### B.13 Subscriber Analytics, Cohorts, LTV/Retention Dashboards

| Vendor | Analytics depth |
|---|---|
| **RevenueCat** | Charts, MRR, subscriber counts, retention curves, cohort analysis; App Store Revenue Calculator powered by 115K+ apps dataset |
| **Adapty** | Real-time analytics; ARPU/ARPPU; LTV by category/region; predictive LTV; pricing benchmarks |
| **Apphud** | Real-time ARPU/ARPPU; trial conversion; churn analysis; data export |
| **Qonversion** | Real-time metrics; trial-to-paid conversions; revenue tracking |
| **Superwall** | Paywall-specific analytics (conversion per variant, placement performance) |

[Primary docs từ mỗi vendor]

### B.14 Holdout & Incrementality Measurement

- **Gap đã xác nhận:** Không vendor nào trong nhóm RevenueCat/Adapty/Superwall/Apphud có **built-in holdout group** cho incrementality measurement. A/B testing của họ so sánh variant-vs-variant, không phải treatment-vs-no-exposure. [Nghiên cứu này xác minh qua docs chính thức của RevenueCat Experiments, Adapty A/B testing, Superwall Experiments — không có "holdout" feature]
- **Workaround:** Apps layer external MMPs (AppsFlyer Incrementality, Tenjin, Haus.io, Measured) hoặc tự build holdout mechanism. [Secondary — appsflyer.com/products/measurement/incrementality, haus.io]
- **Amplitude Holdout Groups:** Amplitude Experiment có built-in holdout groups feature. [Primary docs — amplitude.com/docs/feature-experiment/advanced-techniques/holdout-groups]
- **Opportunity:** Đây là white space — SDK nào tích hợp native holdout/incrementality measurement sẽ có lợi thế rõ ràng.

### B.15 Server-side Webhook/Event APIs

Tất cả Tier 1 vendors cung cấp:
- **Webhook endpoints** cho real-time subscription events (new subscription, renewal, cancellation, refund, billing retry, expiration, grace period, account hold). [Primary docs]
- **REST API** cho programmatic access (subscriber lookup, entitlement management, offering configuration). [Primary docs]
- **Server-to-server notifications:** Apple App Store Server Notifications V2; Google RTDN — vendors wrap cả hai. [Primary docs]

### B.16 No-code Integrations

**RevenueCat integrations (30+):** Amplitude, Braze, Segment, Mixpanel, AppsFlyer, Adjust, Slack, Firebase, OneSignal, Airship, Zapier, CleverTap, Insider, Intercom, Customer.io, Iterable, mParticle… [Primary docs — revenuecat.com/docs/integrations]

**Adapty integrations (20+):** Amplitude, Braze, AppsFlyer, Adjust, Mixpanel, Firebase, OneSignal, Segment, Airbridge… [Primary docs — adapty.io]

**Event taxonomy chung:** subscription started, trial started, trial converted, subscription renewed, subscription cancelled, subscription expired, refund issued, billing retry, grace period entered, billing issue resolved. [Primary docs]

## D. Góc nhìn Gaming-specific

### D.1 Các model subscription trong game

**Battle Pass / Season Pass:**
- Dominant subscription-like model trong mobile gaming. GameRefinery data: creative battle pass implementation found trong 60% top-grossing mobile games. [Secondary — pocketgamer.biz/gamerefinery-battle-pass]
- Battle pass không phải "true subscription" theo nghĩa App Store — thường được implement như **non-renewing IAP** (one-time purchase mỗi season), không phải auto-renewable subscription. [Secondary — gameanalytics.com; adriancrook.com]
- Unity có dedicated Battle Passes service trong Unity Solutions. [Primary docs — docs.unity.com/en-us/services/solutions/battle-passes]

**VIP Subscription / Premium Membership:**
- Recurring QoL/cosmetic benefits (daily rewards, exclusive content, ad-free, boosted progression). [Secondary — naavik.co]
- Naavik analysis: VIP subs drive 2.5–4x more revenue so với non-subscribers; leverage loss aversion để boost LTV. [Secondary — naavik.co/f2p-mobile/vip-subscriptions]
- Tiered pricing (VIP Bronze/Silver/Gold) là pattern phổ biến. [Secondary — adriancrook.com]

**Remove-Ads Subscription:**
- Đơn giản nhất; recurring payment để tắt quảng cáo; phổ biến trong casual/hyper-casual games. [Secondary — appfollow.io/blog/mobile-game-monetization 07/2026]

**Daily Cards / Daily Login Subscription:**
- Model mới: daily reward allocation cho subscribers; tạo habit loop. [Secondary — naavik.co]

**Ecosystem Passes:**
- Cross-game subscription (ví dụ: Xbox Game Pass, Apple Arcade, Netflix Games). [Secondary]

### D.2 SDK nào games đang dùng?

| Layer | SDKs | Ghi chú |
|---|---|---|
| **Platform IAP** | Unity IAP, Apple StoreKit, Google Play Billing | Bắt buộc; games phải dùng native billing |
| **Subscription management** | RevenueCat, Adapty, Xsolla | Chỉ games có subscription component mới dùng |
| **Game economy backend** | PlayFab, Firebase, custom backend | Quản lý virtual currency, inventory, battle pass tiers |
| **LiveOps/CRM** | Xsolla LiveOps, custom CRM | Tailored offers, events, seasonal content |

[Primary docs; Secondary — adriancrook.com, xsolla.com, businessofapps.com]

**Quan trọng:** Top-grossing games (Honor of Kings, Roblox, Last War, Clash Royale — $1B+ annually) thường **tự build** IAP/subscription infrastructure trên nền platform billing, không dùng RevenueCat/Adapty. Lý do: họ cần control sâu game economy (virtual currency conversion, bundle logic, progression-gated offers) mà subscription SDK truyền thống không hỗ trợ. [Secondary — mobilegamer.biz, singular.net]

### D.3 Khoảng trống cho games (gap mà subscription SDK truyền thống không cover)

1. **Virtual currency ↔ subscription bridge:** Subscription SDK hiểu "entitlement = access", không hiểu "entitlement = 500 gems/ngày + battle pass tier unlock". Game cần SDK hiểu cả IAP consumable và subscription entitlement trong cùng one economy.
2. **Season/temporal logic:** Battle pass có mùa (30/60/90 ngày), content reset, progression tiers — không vendor nào trong nhóm RevenueCat/Adapty handle temporal game content.
3. **Progression-gated offers:** Offer unlock khi player đạt level X, complete quest Y — cần game state awareness mà subscription SDK không có.
4. **Hybrid monetization decisioning:** Game cần quyết định per-user: hiện battle pass offer, hay VIP subscription prompt, hay IAP bundle, hay rewarded ad — dựa trên player state. Subscription SDK chỉ handle subscription part.
5. **Cross-game entitlements:** Ecosystem passes (multiple games under one subscription) — chưa vendor nào support.
6. **Server-authoritative game state:** Games cần server validate progression trước khi grant entitlement — khác với app subscription (Apple/Google authorize).

[Design synthesis — tổng hợp từ nhiều nguồn]

## E. Implications cho SDK của chúng ta

### E.1 Feature checklist bắt buộc phải match (parity)

| # | Feature | Priority | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | No-code paywall builder (native rendering) | P0 | Table stakes; must be SwiftUI + Compose |
| 2 | Remote configuration (no app release) | P0 | Table stakes |
| 3 | A/B testing (≥4 variants, flexible split) | P0 | Match Adapty/Superwall level |
| 4 | Introductory offer / free trial eligibility | P0 | Wrap StoreKit + Play Billing |
| 5 | Win-back offers (iOS) | P1 | Wrap Apple WWDC24 feature |
| 6 | Offer codes | P1 | Wrap Apple + Google |
| 7 | Billing grace period + retry tracking | P0 | Wrap both platforms |
| 8 | Account hold handling (Android) | P0 | Wrap Google Play lifecycle |
| 9 | Subscription groups / upgrade-downgrade | P1 | Wrap both platforms |
| 10 | Cross-platform entitlement sync | P0 | Core value prop |
| 11 | Webhook/API cho subscription events | P0 | Table stakes |
| 12 | Subscriber analytics + cohorts + LTV | P1 | Match RevenueCat/Adapty dashboards |
| 13 | Integrations (Amplitude, Braze, Segment, AppsFlyer, Adjust) | P1 | Minimum 10 integrations |
| 14 | Price localization / PPP support | P2 | Differentiator nếu built-in |
| 15 | Dunning management / smart retry | P2 | Value-add feature |
| 16 | Holdout & incrementality measurement | P2 | **White space — chưa ai làm** |
| 17 | Family sharing / group subscriptions | P2 | Wrap WWDC26 group purchase khi available |
| 18 | 12-month commitment plans | P2 | Wrap WWDC26 feature |
| 19 | Refund & chargeback handling | P1 | Match Adapty Refund Saver |
| 20 | Price elasticity experiments | P2 | Built-in elasticity testing |

### E.2 2–3 cơ hội differentiation cho games

**1. Game-aware subscription layer:**
- SDK hiểu cả subscription entitlement VÀ game economy state (virtual currency balance, battle pass tier, player level, season timer).
- API: `grantSubscriptionBenefit(type: .dailyGems(500), condition: .levelGte(10))` thay vì chỉ `entitlement.isActive`.
- Không vendor nào trong nhóm RevenueCat/Adapty/Superwall có game-state awareness.

**2. Hybrid monetization decisioning cho subscription context:**
- Khi player xem paywall, SDK quyết định: hiện VIP subscription, hay battle pass offer, hay IAP bundle, hay rewarded ad prompt — dựa trên player state + predicted LTV.
- Tích hợp causal uplift measurement (từ doc 05) vào paywall decisioning — đây là convergence point giữa "subscription brain" và "player decision platform".

**3. Temporal/season-aware subscription management:**
- Native support cho season pass lifecycle (start, mid-season, end-season, transition).
- Auto-renewal logic cho seasonal subscriptions (season 2 auto-unlock nếu season 1 subscriber).
- Progression-gated offers (unlock premium tier khi complete milestone).
- Cross-season retention mechanics (loyalty bonus cho multi-season subscribers).

## F. Benchmark data nổi bật (2026)

Từ RevenueCat State of Subscription Apps 2026 (115,000 apps, $16B revenue): [Case study — self-reported]
- Top 10% apps capture 94.5% subscription revenue (tăng từ 92.7% năm 2023).
- Hard paywall convert 10.7% vs. freemium 2.1% — gap 5x (một số nguồn nói 8x).
- Day 0 cancellation rate: 55.4%.
- AI apps churn 36% nhanh hơn non-AI apps.
- Google Play billing failures chiếm 31% cancellations.

Từ Adapty State of In-App Subscriptions 2026 (16,000 apps, $3B revenue): [Case study — self-reported]
- 95% revenue thuộc top 10% apps.
- 44.5% users reject paywall tại một thời điểm.
- European users trả nhiều hơn cho subscription apps.
- Subscription fatigue patterns identified ở 3 điểm chính trong user journey.

## Không xác minh được (ghi rõ)

1. **Purchasely bị Airbridge mua lại:** Không tìm thấy bất kỳ evidence nào cho acquisition này. Cả hai công ty vẫn hoạt động độc lập tính đến 08/2026. Câu hỏi ban đầu "Purchasely (acquired by Airbridge? verify)" → **không đúng**.

2. **RevenueCat exact revenue processed:** RevenueCat claim "$16B+ tracked" trong benchmark report nhưng đây là aggregate dataset, không phải annual revenue họ process. Con số exact monthly processing volume không được công bố công khai.

3. **Game studios lớn dùng subscription SDK nào:** Top-grossing games (Honor of Kings, PUBG Mobile, etc.) không công bố tech stack cho subscription/IAP layer. Inference dựa trên job postings, GDC talks, và community discussions — không phải confirmed fact.

4. **Naavik "2.5–4x more revenue" VIP subscription claim:** Self-reported analysis, không có independent verification.

5. **Mirava.io "15–122% revenue increase" từ PPP pricing:** Single vendor claim, sample size và methodology không rõ.

6. **Adapty "95% revenue top 10%" vs. RevenueCat "94.5%":** Hai con số gần identical từ hai reports độc lập — có thể phản ánh cùng underlying reality, nhưng mỗi vendor dùng dataset và methodology riêng.

7. **WWDC 2026 features (Group Subscriptions, Bundles & Suites):** Announced nhưng chưa fully available tại thời điểm nghiên cứu (08/2026). Timeline rollout cụ thể chưa rõ.
